install_description: ocbar builds from source on your Mac through Homebrew. After installation, the setup wizard helps you add your gateway and sign in.
disclaimer: Not affiliated with Cisco. AnyConnect describes protocol compatibility.
title: ocbar — same AnyConnect VPN, your rules
description: Open-source client for AnyConnect-compatible VPN gateways on macOS: password and TOTP filled in for you, your own networks and DNS, a native menu instead of a terminal.
lead: Your networks, your DNS, your menu. Open source, built on OpenConnect.
demo_alt: ocbar menu: connect, switch off a network, pause
demo_caption: The real menu on a demo profile.
p1_t: Password and code filled in for you
p1_d: Password and one-time code come from Keychain, KeePassXC or your own command. The sign-in window shows up only when a person is needed.
p2_t: You choose the networks, not the admin
p2_d: Only the networks in your profile go through the tunnel; everything else, home network included, goes the usual way. Switch them from the menu without reconnecting.
p3_t: Smart DNS: yours and the company’s at once
p3_d: Company domains resolve through the company DNS, everything else through yours. System DNS stays untouched.
p4_d: A native macOS menu: connect, pause, switch networks, read logs. A setup wizard and a profile editor; the CLI is there for automation.
p5_d: The supervisor brings the connection back after sleep, Wi-Fi changes and dropped links, without opening a sign-in window on its own.
install_note: Homebrew builds ocbar on your Mac. The first command with sudo installs the network helper; then the setup wizard adds your gateway.
requirements: macOS 13+ · Command Line Tools · your own AnyConnect-compatible gateway
